_comment: Regression gate. CI fails if any metric crosses its bound. Raise floors as the system improves; never lower one without a note in the PR explaining why.
_p1_comment: P1 recall/over-escalation floors added Oct 2026 with the fraud/takeover escalation rule. holdout_v1 is now a seen regression set (held to 100% P1 recall). holdout_v2 floors (recall >= 80, over-escalation <= 10) were pre-registered before it was first run; with ~7 P1s they allow one miss. Shadow-mode go/no-go still requires 100% P1 recall on live tickets.
